response: The current clusters are organized by topic/subject matter, but your goal is to cluster by methodology. Reorganize all papers into four methodology-based groups: Observational (papers analyzing telescope/instrument data), Theoretical (analytical or first-principles work), Simulation (numerical simulations, N-body, hydrodynamics, etc.), and Instrumental/Methods (papers about instruments, pipelines, or statistical techniques). Right now every cluster mixes all four methodologies together — for example, "Cosmology" contains both simulation-based inference tools and observational constraints, which should be in separate methodology clusters.
